name: Balance Point
disable: DC 20 Thievery check (trained) to attach the balanced stone floor piece to the actual floor and lock it in place, or DC 23 Crafting check (trained) to jury-rig a quick bit of extra support to prevent the floor from tilting

items.name: Tipping Floor
items.text:
Trigger A creature walks onto one side of the false floor

---
Effect The triggering creature falls into the pit and takes 20 bludgeoning damage from the fall unless they grab-an-edge dc=23. It's a DC 20 Athletics check check to climb the pit walls.

text: A 40-foot deep pit is obscured by a false floor set over a single balance point. Pressure on either side to the east or west causes occupants to fall into the depths below.
